text: The Cocos (Keeling) Islands consist of two coral atolls. It is an Australian territory, so for country streaks purposes, it is counted as Australia.
text_zh: 科科斯（基林）群島由兩個珊瑚環礁組成。它是澳洲屬地，因此就連續國家挑戰而言，它被算作澳洲。

text: The general landscape consists of **bright white sand**, **many palms** and mowed grass. Cocos Islands is significantly less forested or hilly compared to Christmas Island.
text_zh: 整體景觀由**明亮的白沙**、**許多棕櫚樹**與修剪過的草皮組成。與聖誕島相比，科科斯群島的森林或丘陵少得多。

text: This unique car with a **snorkel** at the front right and the edges of the bed visible is found on West Island.
text_zh: 右前側有**呼吸管**且車斗邊緣可見的這個獨特車輛可以在西島（West Island）找到。

text: This white car with the **rear edges visible** is found in Bantam.
NOTE: The car may be fully blurred. Make sure to look out for other clues before guessing.
text_zh: 車輛**後部邊緣可見**的這個白色汽車可以在班坦（Bantam）找到。
註：該車輛可能會完全模糊。在猜測前，請務必尋找其他線索。

text: Bantam Village can be recognized by the **cross-hatched** brick pavement.
text_zh: 班坦村可以透過**交錯網紋**的磚造路面來識別。

text: The Cocos Islands runway can be recognized by it being the widest paved road on the island, with mowed grass on both sides of the runway and this [follow car](https://goo.gl/maps/evWNsAeXZ9ScSxqW9).
text_zh: 科科斯群島跑道可以透過它是島上最寬的鋪面道路來識別，跑道兩側皆有修剪過的草皮以及這台[跟拍車](https://goo.gl/maps/evWNsAeXZ9ScSxqW9)。

text: Cocos Islands has many trekkers along the **coast**. Most of them will be walking on white sand, with the ocean to one side and **palms** the other.
text_zh: 科科斯群島沿著**海岸**有許多徒步拍攝。牠們大多數會走在白沙上，一側是大海，另一側則是**棕櫚樹**。

text: Direction Island can be recognized by the beaches having significantly more **litter** compared to the other islands. [Bricks](https://goo.gl/maps/tSjoPrWjNQyRNRig7), [styrofoam](https://goo.gl/maps/Yvcoa9whDkWhEQDT7) and [dead coral](https://goo.gl/maps/3jQPVmeJT2PCunwY9) can be seen along some portions of the coast.
In addition, the trekker can be seen walking between many palms [inland](https://goo.gl/maps/63zUyWmqRJoKygM38).
text_zh: 方向島（Direction Island）可以透過海灘與其他島嶼相比有顯著較多的**垃圾**來識別。沿著海岸的一些部分可以看到[磚塊](https://goo.gl/maps/tSjoPrWjNQyRNRig7)、[保麗龍](https://goo.gl/maps/Yvcoa9whDkWhEQDT7)與[死珊瑚](https://goo.gl/maps/3jQPVmeJT2PCunwY9)。
此外，可以看到徒步拍攝在[內陸](https://goo.gl/maps/63zUyWmqRJoKygM38)的許多棕櫚樹之間行走。

text: The inland trekker on Pulau Luar (Horsburgh Island) can be recognized by the **dry**, yellow grass, and more **sparse** vegetation.
text_zh: 盧阿爾島（Pulau Luar，即霍斯堡島 Horsburgh Island）的內陸徒步拍攝可以透過**乾燥**的黃草以及更**稀疏**的植被來識別。

text: This medium boat with a **large seating capacity** can be seen from West Island to Bantam.
text_zh: 從西島到班坦可以看到這艘擁有**大載客量**的中型船隻。

text: This small boat with **black bars** at the rear can be seen in the north.
text_zh: 在北部可以看到這艘後方有**黑色欄杆**的小船。

text: This small dark grey boat with a **woman** sitting at the back can be seen in the south.
text_zh: 在南部可以看到這艘後方坐著一位**女性**的小型深灰色船隻。
